instruction: Use three distinct reviewed visual references to propose left-first, right-first, and synchronized two-arm T-shirt folding candidates. Preserve one shirt, both original sleeves, visible causal contact, continuous motion, a fixed camera and background, and the terminal placement declared by each strategy plan.

entities.description: white robot arm entering from the lower-left camera region
white robot arm entering from the upper-right camera region
original viewer-left black sleeve in the named camera frame
original viewer-right black sleeve in the named camera frame

unavailable_evidence: calibrated metric depth or cloth mesh
exact robot URDF or joint trajectory

use reviewed examples only as camera-pixel proposal priors
never relax or delete a material, contact, continuity, task-order, background, or human-review gate
